text: In moments of despair, open to God. When it seems to you that everything has collapsed, that you have done everything possible and have no strength left, stop fighting. Simply raise your hands upward in a gesture of acceptance, connect with your attention to God (the Universe), whose intentions are significantly larger than your ability to understand them, and sincerely say: “Thy will be done. I trust you!”. This act of capitulation before the Higher Design is not a defeat; it is the moment when your personal will unites with the will of the Universe, and help comes.
